cd /workspace/submission && python3 - <<'PY'
import exact,time,resource
N=512;P=512;T=1;S=512;Q=1;O=0
links=[]
for l in range(1024):
    a=l%N
    b=(a+1+(l//N))%N
    if a==b:b=(b+1)%N
    slot=l//N
    links.append({'ends':[[a,slot,0],[b,slot,1]],'delay_ns':[5+l%7,5+l%7],'defer_rounds':[l%3,(l+1)%3]})
fabric={'n':N,'interval_ns':T,'slice_ns':S,'offset_ns':O,'drift_ppb':[i%10 for i in range(N)],'heat':[],'anchors':[[0,0,P]],'links':links,'slices':[list(range(1024))],'blackouts':[],'guards_ns':[0,10,20,40,80,160,320,480],'reconfig_ns':0}
prof={'groups':2,'jitter_ps':[1,2],'measurements':[[0,1,-10,10]]}
t=time.time();cal=exact.solve_calibration(prof);print('cal',time.time()-t,flush=True)
t=time.time();fab=exact.Fabric(fabric);print('parse',time.time()-t,'V',fab.V,'P',fab.P,'mem',resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss,flush=True)
t=time.time();comp=exact.compute_plan_exact(fab,cal);print('compute',time.time()-t,'peaks',comp['peaks_by_index'],'best',None if comp['best'] is None else comp['best'][0],'mem',resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss,flush=True)
t=time.time();art=exact.make_plan_artifact(fab,cal);print('artifact',time.time()-t,'mem',resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss,flush=True)
PY
